ISL.name: resistance-island stratification
ISL.null: the existing NM-C1-004 matrices, unchanged; no new permutation
ISL.rule: occurrences on a replicon are single-linkage clustered at a 10000 bp gap; a cluster of >= 3 occurrences is an island, everything else is isolated
ISL.what_it_is_not: not a core/accessory partition and not AbaR/AbGRI identification by backbone. A structural proxy for multi-gene resistance islands, reported as such.

LOC.both_radii_registered_now: R = 50 kb and R = 100 kb are fixed here together, so neither can be selected after seeing the other
LOC.deliberate_difference_from_NM_C1_001: relocated intervals are not forced to be mutually non-overlapping. Within a local window around a resistance-gene cluster the constraint is frequently unsatisfiable, and it does not enter this estimator: each occurrence's distance depends only on its own interval and the frozen element coordinates.
LOC.estimator: unchanged - F(1 kb) under the NMIS complete-structural element definition, right-censored at 10 kb
LOC.name: local relocation null
LOC.rule: each chromosomal occurrence is relocated uniformly within +/-R of its own start instead of anywhere on its chromosome; interval length, chromosome, genome, species and BioProject identity preserved; circular chromosomes wrap; linear chromosomes exclude positions whose +/-10 kb window would run past an end, exactly as in NM-C1-001

decision_rule.accessory_location_explains_the_effect_i: A. baumannii's enrichment fails to exclude its null 95% interval under ARM LOC at R = 100 kb, or fails to exclude it among ISOLATED occurrences under ARM ISL, or the A. baumannii / Klebsiella contrast falls below 1.5 in either
decision_rule.reported_regardless: every arm, every radius and every stratum, whatever they show
decision_rule.thresholds_reused_from: NM-C1-006, 007 and 008, deliberately, rather than chosen now

raised_by: the uniform relocation null does not preserve accessory-genome location; resistance genes and insertion sequences may both concentrate in accessory regions, in which case a chromosome-wide null overstates the enrichment
scope_limit: no core-genome alignment exists in this project, so no accessory-restricted null was run. ARM LOC is the closest available approximation and is reported as an approximation, not as an accessory-restricted null.
title: Accessory-context arms for the background-normalised enrichment
